title: Pixel Persona Integration & Textured Vector Shading
subtitle: Raster Brushes, Grain Shading, Child Pixel Layers & Non-Destructive Vector Masking
description: Harness the hybrid creative superpower of Affinity Designer: switch seamlessly into the Pixel Persona, leverage pressure-sensitive raster grain brushes, clip textured shading non-destructively inside mathematical vector shells, and balance raster DPI with vector scalability for commercial print and digital workflows.
prerequisites: D01: Designer Interface, Personas & Canvas Setup
D04: Fill, Gradient, Stroke & Pressure Profiles
D05: Layer Organization, Masks & Clipping Paths
learningOutcomes: Switch fluidly between Designer Persona and Pixel Persona using verified keyboard shortcuts.
Master raster brush dynamics including Flow, Opacity, Hardness, Spacing, and Pressure Jitter.
Clip raster pixel layers non-destructively inside parent vector curves via child layer nesting.
Lock transparency using Protect Alpha to recolor existing texture passes without overspill.
Govern document DPI settings to prevent pixelation while maintaining infinite vector scalability.

capstoneProject.title: Retro-Futuristic Botanical Vector-Raster Masterpiece
capstoneProject.description: Construct an editorial illustration combining sharp vector silhouettes, parametric curves, and multi-pass analog grain shading clipped non-destructively within vector leaf and stem shells at 300 DPI.
evaluationCriteria: Document calibrated at 300 DPI for high-resolution raster reproduction.
Textured shading isolated onto child pixel layers inside parent vector curves.
Flow dynamics (15%–25%) utilized for velvety, non-banding grain gradients.
Vector curves remain editable with live clipping boundaries updating in real time.
